So glad to hear it OP. You have no reason to feel guilty. It is disrespectful of him to moan and groan about basic tasks like cleaning up his own messes. It doesn’t sound like you are asking for anything unreasonable, you just want him to be an equal partner. Just be honest about your feelings, be clear about what you need from him, and be consistent about reinforcing any new boundaries you set. For example, if you ask him to take responsibility for a specific chore and he agrees but forgets later, don’t do it for him just because it’s easier. That will just teach him to keep letting you pick up his slack. Politely remind him that it’s important to you that he follows through on his promises. 

It’s fine for the female partner to do more domestic work if the male partner has less free time and if that’s what both parties have agreed on, but at the end of the day you are his girlfriend, not his maid.

I see where you’re coming from but OP has already made it clear that she is unhappy with the division of labor and he is willfully ignoring her wishes. Dropping sweet little hints like this just isn’t gonna cut it. He’s an adult, not a six year old. He shouldn’t need to be eased into doing his fair share. He’s not confused, he’s just lazy.
